meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Money stock (M1, M2, M3), its components and its sources, every reporting fortnight since 1951, with the series excluding the HDFC merger beside the plain ones
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 25 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Amounts in ₹ crore. 357 cells the source prints more than once with different values (1956-03-23, 1962-03-30, 1965-03-26, 1968-03-22 and other dates) are left out: we cannot tell which value is right. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (57 values, e.g. 1.1.2 Government deposits with RBI on 2014-07-25; 1.1.2 Government deposits with RBI on 2014-08-22; 1.1.2 Government deposits with RBI on 2014-09-19).
